title: Will Travis Kelce play today? Status update for Chiefs TE in Week 8
text:
Travis Kelce injury: Will Chiefs TE play vs. Broncos today in Week 8? Schedule NFL News Draft Fantasy Odds Betting Newsletter CHIEFS Will Travis Kelce play today? Status update for Chiefs TE in Week 8
 John Dillon Chiefs Wire Nov. 1, 2026, 7:45 a.m. CT Travis Kelce was listed on the Kansas City Chiefs ' injury report ahead of the team's Week 8 tilt with the Denver Broncos at Empower Field.
 Is Kelce expected to suit up to face the Broncos this afternoon?
 Here's the latest update on Kelce's status:
 Travis Kelce status update
 An ankle injury limited Kelce's participation in Kansas City's workouts on Thursday, but he was a full participant in the Chiefs' practice sessions on Wednesday and Friday.
 Your fantasy edge starts here Sync your league for custom roster advice, projections, and tools to win your matchups every week. How long will Travis Kelce be out?
 Kelce isn't expected to miss any time due to his ankle injury. Kansas City declined to assign Kelce an official game status designation, so Chiefs fans should expect to see the star tight end in action against the Broncos this afternoon.
 Chiefs TE depth chart
 Veteran tight ends Noah Gray, Jared Wiley, and Jake Briningstool will be available to fill in for Kelce if the former Cincinnati Bearcat aggravates his ankle injury in Week 8.
